pb-seo-publish.title: Send an approved article
pb-seo-publish.boundary: Connect the client site in Connections. Both you and the client must approve the current article first.
pb-seo-publish.needsApproval: This article is not ready. Check its owner and client approvals, evidence and site connection.
pb-seo-publish.saved: Draft saved. Review and publish it in WordPress.
pb-seo-publish.notSent: No draft was sent. Review the connection before starting again.
pb-seo-publish.unknown: WordPress may have saved it. Inspect the site; do not send it again.
pb-seo-publish.verified: Page structure checked with a dated receipt. No ranking claim.
pb-seo-publish.verifyFailed: The observed page does not match the approved title and main heading.
pb-seo-publish.failed: This action could not finish. Reopen the current evidence and check the client approval and connection.
pb-seo-publish.edge.title: Advanced: reviewed edge change
pb-seo-publish.edge.boundary: Use a key your developer already connected to the client site. Replacement text must appear in the client-approved article.
pb-seo-publish.edge.staged: Prepared for review. No key changed.
pb-seo-publish.edge.applied: Written and read back. Edge propagation can take time.
pb-seo-publish.edge.undone: Previous value restored and read back.
pb-seo-publish.edge.inspect: The write could not be confirmed. Inspect Cloudflare; Chausar will not retry.
